originality.rationale: Ulas–Ulas 2011 and Gawron 2014 were materially inspected; Deshouillers–Schinzel 2019 full text gives the general automaton density principle (Theorem 2.2) and the t=1 primitive orbit (Proposition 3.2), but not the negative-two generator orbit. The new specific ingredient is an exact conjugate opposite-shear construction proving the all-odd-modulus orbit. Actual semantic and exact searches gave no equivalent specialization. Unlocated stronger group generation results remain a residual risk.
residual_risks: An unlocated general orbit-generation theorem for Stern-polynomial digit matrices may already establish the primitive-pair orbit at t=-2.

The general invertible-automaton density mechanism is known in Deshouillers–Schinzel 2019, and is credited; originality rests only on the specific negative-two primitive orbit and resulting explicit formulas.
No semantic index or literature search can establish exhaustive novelty.
